description: Compute the authenticated user's market position score (0-100). Pro tier. Weighted: 50% skill demand against current market, 20% seniority fit, 15% remote availability for the user's preference, 15% skill breadth. Returns score, matchingJobs count, salaryMedian for matching roles, per-skill demand breakdown, and the top companies whose tech stacks align best with the user's skills. Use for queries like 'how do I stack up against the market?' or 'what's my market position right now?'. Not for job-specific (`match_job`) or company-specific (`company_fit`) scores.
name: market_position

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: The authenticated user's overall market position

matchingJobs.description: Conservative estimate of jobs matching the user's top skills

message.description: Present (with score 0) when the profile has no skills or market data is unavailable

remoteAvailPct.description: Share of jobs that are remote or hybrid, 0-100

score.description: Market position score, 0-100 (skill demand 50%, seniority fit 20%, remote availability 15%, skill breadth 15%)

seniorityJobPct.description: Share of jobs at the user's seniority level, 0-100

skillDemand.description: Per-skill market demand for each of the user's skills, highest demand first

companyPct.description: Share of tracked companies mentioning it, 0-100

rank.description: Rank among top market skills; null when not ranked

topMatchingCompanies.description: Companies whose tech stacks best overlap the user's skills (capped at 10)

matchingSkills.description: How many of the user's skills appear in the company's top skills

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: Market Position
